videos.title: Introduction to Symfony 6 | Symfony 6 for Beginners | Learn Symfony 6 from Scratch | Learn Symfony
videos.description: This video introduces Symfony 6, an open-source PHP framework for building high-performance web applications. It covers what Symfony is, its advantages, coding standards, and a guide on learning the framework from scratch.

videos.title: Login & Register System in Symfony | Symfony Authentication | Symfony 6 for Beginners
videos.description: This video teaches how to implement login and registration systems in Symfony 6. It covers creating user entities, database migrations, and the logic for both registering new users and handling user authentication, including login and logout functionalities within a Symfony…

videos.title: How to Send Email in PHP - Symfony Mailer - Email Protocols - Mailhog Setup - Full PHP 8 Tutorial
videos.description: The video covers sending email in PHP using Symfony Mailer, detailing email protocols like SMTP, POP3, and IMAP. It also demonstrates how to set up Mailhog for local email testing.

videos.title: Symfony Forms Tutorial
videos.description: Learn a practical approach to building and handling forms in Symfony using Form Types, Twig rendering, validation with Symfony Validator, CSRF protection, Doctrine persistence, and unmapped fields. This tutorial demonstrates creating an entity, generating a form type, rendering…

videos.title: [1/9] - Beginners Symfony 4 Tutorial - Getting Started With Symfony 4
videos.description: This tutorial introduces Symfony 4 by demonstrating project creation with `symfony/website-skeleton`, clarifying its distinction from `symfony/skeleton`. It covers the initial setup for building applications with the framework.

videos.title: [2/9] - Beginners Symfony 4 Tutorial - Make Your Own Controller
videos.description: This video tutorial demonstrates how to create a custom controller and method in Symfony 4. It covers the process of defining a controller class and its actions to handle routes and render templates, contrasting with Symfony's built-in TemplateController.

videos.title: Installation & Setup for Mac | Symfony 6 for Beginners | Learn Symfony 6 from Scratch
videos.description: This video outlines the installation and setup of a Symfony 6 development environment on Mac, demonstrating how to configure PHP, MySQL, and Composer using Homebrew for Symfony projects.

videos.title: Twig in Symfony | Symfony 6 for Beginners | Learn Symfony 6 from Scratch | Learn Symfony
videos.description: This video teaches Twig as Symfony's templating engine, covering its use in Symfony 6. Topics include blocks, extending/overwriting templates, array handling, comments, and global variables within the Twig environment for PHP web applications.

videos.title: Symfony 5 Authentication Tutorial Part 1
videos.description: This video, part one of a series, outlines Symfony 5 authentication, covering user registration, login, "remember me" functionality, and login attempt throttling. It also touches on implementing user roles within a Symfony application.

videos.title: What is Symfony, Symfony, Twig and Doctrine Beginners Tutorial
videos.description: This video introduces Symfony, Twig, and Doctrine for beginners. It covers Symfony installation, controllers, routing, and using Twig for views. It also provides an introduction to Doctrine ORM and building basic CRUD web applications with external assets.

videos.title: [3/9] - Beginners Symfony 4 Tutorial - Let Twig Do The Hard Work
videos.description: Learn to create maintainable and scalable web pages in your Symfony 4 projects by leveraging the power of Twig's template inheritance. This tutorial addresses the common problem of code duplication across multiple pages by demonstrating how to create a master `base.html.twig`…

videos.title: [1/7] - Symfony 3 Tutorial - Getting Started with Symfony 3
videos.description: Kickstart your journey with Symfony 3 with this beginner-friendly tutorial. Learn the fundamentals of the Symfony framework by building a practical web application that interacts with the GitHub API. This guide covers essential concepts including project setup, configuring the…

videos.title: Beginners Guide to Doctrine with Symfony 3 - Part 1 of 7
videos.description: This video provides a beginner's guide to integrating and using Doctrine with Symfony 3, offering an introductory, hands-on tutorial for database interaction within the framework.

videos.title: Beginners Guide to Symfony 2.7
videos.description: This video series covers installing Symfony 2.7 and its core components, including Controllers, Routing, Doctrine, and Forms. It details application structure, route management, data manipulation, form submission/validation, security fundamentals, user management, and testing.
